clause_reference: Missing (expected after Clause 9, Term and Termination)
description: The NDA does not state which law governs it or which courts have jurisdiction. If a dispute arises, the parties may first have to litigate where and under which law the claim is heard, which delays any injunction against disclosure.
remedy_suggested: Add a clause: "This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with it."
citation: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, s. 20; Indian Contract Act, 1872, s. 28 (Exception 1)
